description: LICENSE-DATA.md (sha dd5d78ade261, reviewed this date) carries no amendment for the Pearson Student Book PDF hosting; the plan asserts operator rights from the 2026-10-18 package intake (trace 1a14f8bf97b983f1, 'I have rights on hosting', recorded in contracts/books.ts header) but the notice-of-record file does not carry it. SME corpora + CAIE extension + CIE specs ARE covered.
root_cause: the hosting-rights assertion lives in session record + contract header only; it never propagated into the licensing notice of record (single-source violation across two repos)
fix: none yet — ADR adopts the release-gate law: no Phase C full-book flip until the LICENSE-DATA.md amendment lands (operator follow-up); Phase A pilot continues under live T-MIG-133 posture at pilot scale

description: PLAN-4CH1 v1.0/v1.1 §5 specified 'attempts.surface add book_check discriminator' as a migration item, but the attempts table has NO surface column — the discriminator is attempts.provenance (free varchar 40, no ck), and attempts is Flyway-owned (frozen-core law: no structural DDL while the Java core lives). The plan named a column that does not exist in the DB of record.
root_cause: plan §5 was drafted against remembered shapes instead of reading the DB of record first (schema-first lesson); the plan-v1.0 session had repo access blocked and v1.1 carried the table wording over unverified
fix: discriminator is the app-level contracts constant ATTEMPT_PROVENANCE_BOOK_CHECK='BOOK_CHECK'; ZERO DDL on attempts; plan errata appended
